findings.description: Use case UC-001 references entity E-011 (DiscountCode) claiming it is defined in billing-boundary/domain-model.md, but that document was opened and parsed and does not contain an entity with ID E-011. Only E-010 (Invoice) is actually defined there. The reference does not resolve against the real document.

fixture_notes: Demonstrates the validator must actually open and parse defined_in targets rather than trusting a manifest's claim at face value. A validator implementation that merely checks the JSON shape of the reference (without resolving it against real domain-model.md content) would incorrectly report PASS on this fixture -- that is the specific failure mode this fixture exists to catch.
